description:
Get the status and, once finished, the result of an audit started with test_conversion.

Pass the audit_id returned by test_conversion (a report URL also works). status is "pending" while the agent is still running: wait retry_after_seconds and call again. If stale is true, the audit will never finish; start a new one.

When status is "completed", result contains: task_completed (did the agent reach the goal), score (0-100 Agent Conversion Score, or null when score_withheld because the run did not finish measuring), summary, successes, frictions and recommendations; evidence.steps lists what the agent did. failure_classification explains a non-clean run: "blocked" (safety boundary or site-side access refusal such as a bot challenge — a real finding about the site), "run_did_not_finish", "infrastructure_failure" or "pipeline_error" (Agent Conversion's own problem, not the site's). report_url is a human-readable report to share.

status "failed" means no report will be produced. Calling this tool is free and safe to repeat.

audit_id.description: The audit_id returned by test_conversion, or the report URL.
